definitions.explanation: A standard polite greeting used when parting for the night or before going to sleep. Literally derives from the respectful request 'please rest.'

examples.japanese: おやすみなさい、⟦また→また：00969_mata⟧⟦{明日|あした}→明日：00501_ashita⟧。
{子|こ}ども⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧「おやすみなさい」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}って→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦{電気|でんき}→電気：09780_denki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{消|け}した→消す：00528_kesu⟧。
examples.english: I said 'good night' to the child and turned off the light.

examples.japanese: {夜遅|よるおそ}く⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{起|お}きている→起きる：00521_okiru⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧「おやすみなさい」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かけて→かける：00854_kakeru⟧⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{寝|ね}た→寝る：00470_neru⟧。
examples.english: I said 'good night' to my family who was still up late and went to bed first.

notes:
USAGE:
The polite form of ⟦おやすみ→おやすみ：05206_oyasumi⟧, used with people you are not close with, elders, and in formal situations. The shorter ⟦おやすみ→おやすみ：05206_oyasumi⟧ is used casually among friends and family. Can be used when leaving someone at night (not just at bedtime).

ETYMOLOGY:
Derives from お⟦{休|やす}み→休む：00606_yasumu⟧⟦なさい→なさる：01307_nasaru⟧, a polite request meaning "please rest." The お is an honorific prefix and ⟦なさい→なさる：01307_nasaru⟧ is the imperative of ⟦なさる→なさる：01307_nasaru⟧ (respectful form of ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧).

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦おやすみ→おやすみ：05206_oyasumi⟧: casual form, used among friends and family
- ⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧⟦{夢|ゆめ}→夢：01519_yume⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧: sweet dreams

SIMILAR WORDS:
- おはようございます: good morning — the morning counterpart
- ⟦こんばんは→こんばんは：27858_konbanha⟧: good evening — used earlier in the evening as a greeting, not at parting
